newsitem.title: BELGIUM: "Dead" Belgian tried to con insurers.
newsitem.headline: "Dead" Belgian tried to con insurers.

text.p: A Belgian who tried to swindle insurers out of almost $20 million by playing dead, was found out after he was seen in an African hotel the day after his supposed death.

A spokesman for five insurance companies which acted together in the case said the 41-year-old businessman, identified only as M.D., flew to Burkina Faso in April and had local accomplices send a death certificate and an undertaker's bill to his mother.
The insurers became suspicious and sent investigators to Ouagadougou where the man, who said he had been hoping to save his two firms from bankruptcy, turned himself in.
